custom_floodlight_variables.description: Custom Floodlight variables enable you to capture information beyond the basics (visits and revenue) that you can collect with standard parameters in your tags.

dimensions.description: Report dimensions to include into a sync. The `date` dimension is mandatory for all the report types. The `advertiser` dimension is mandatory for `REACH` report type

enable_all_dimension_combinations.description: Whether to enable all reach dimension combinations in the report. Default value: `false`

metrics.description: Report metrics to include into a sync.

report_configuration_ids.description: You can select only one Floodlight Configuration ID per account.

report_type.description: Type of reporting data to sync. Default value: `STANDARD`.

custom_floodlight_variables.description: Custom Floodlight variables enable you to capture information beyond the basics (visits and revenue) that you can collect with standard parameters in your tags.

dimensions.description: Report dimensions to include in a sync. The `date` dimension is mandatory for all report types. The `advertiser` dimension is mandatory for the `REACH` report type

enable_all_dimension_combinations.description: Specifies whether to enable all reach dimension combinations in the report. Default value: `false`

metrics.description: Report metrics to include into a sync.

report_configuration_ids.description: You can select only one Floodlight Configuration ID per account.

report_type.description: Type of reporting data to sync. Default value: `STANDARD`.

rollback_window.description: The custom window size for rollback syncs (between 1 and 90).

table.description: Destination table name. It must be unique within this connection and must comply with Fivetran's naming conventions.

sync_mode.description: Whether to sync all user profiles or specific ones. Default value: `AllAccounts`.

timeframe_months.description: Number of months' worth of reporting data you'd like to include in your initial sync. A change of this value will trigger a re-sync for enabled reports during the next connector sync. Default value: `TWELVE`.

user_profiles.description: IDs of specific User Profiles to sync. Must be populated if `sync_mode` is set to `SpecificAccounts`.

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your Google Campaign Manager 360 client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your Google Campaign Manager 360 client application.

refresh_token.description: The long-lived `Refresh token` along with the `client_id` and `client_secret` parameters carry the information necessary to get a new access token for API resources.
